[[Melbourne, Florida]] | college = [[University of Kansas|Kansas]] | draft = | draft_year = | draft_team = | career_start = 2008 | career_end = | former_teams = | awards = }} '''Alexander "Sasha" Kaun''' (pronounced Kahn) (born [[May 8]] [[1985]], in [[Tomsk]], [[Russian SFSR]], [[Soviet Union]]), is a [[Russia]]n professional [[basketball]] player for [[PBC CSKA Moscow|CSKA Moscow]]. He is also the 2008 National Champion with the [[Kansas Jayhawks|KU men's basketball team]]. ==Playing Career== Kaun began his basketball career with the [[NCAA]] basketball team [[Kansas Jayhawks]]. After four years there he won the [[NCAA]] title in [[2008 in sports|2008]]. He was mainly the back-up center for the Jayhawks. At the [[Florida Air Academy]] he led his team to a 23-0 record which led him to the Florida championships. In high school, he averaged 13.0 points, 7.0 [[Rebound (basketball)|rebounds]] and 2.0 [[Block (basketball)|blocks]] per game as a junior and 15.3 points and 12.6 rebounds per game as a senior. During fall of 2003 Sasha elected to play college basketball for [[Bill Self]] at Kansas. [[Duke University|Duke]] and [[Michigan State]] also recruited him heavily. During his freshman season playing for Kansas he played in 27 games, starting twice. Sasha ended his sophomore season at KU 25-8 overall with many starts and also helped the Jayhawks to a 80-68 win against the [[Texas Longhorns]] which made Kansas Jayhawks the 2006 [[Big 12 Conference]] champions. He is a computer science major and has been selected to the Academic All Big 12 Basketball Team three times, in [[2006]], [[2007]], and [[2008]]. Kaun has signed a three year contract with [[PBC CSKA Moscow]].[http://www.kansascity.com/166/story/676055.html Former KU center Kaun signs with Russian team][http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/33301/180/cska-signs-terence-morris-sasha-kaun CSKA signs Terence Morris, Sasha Kaun] ==Awards/Achievements== *[[NCAA]] Champion - 2008 ==External links== *[http://kuathletics.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/kaun_sasha00.html Sasha Kaun at the official athletics website of the University of Kansas] * [http://www.sport-express.ru/art.shtml?157250 Interview] {{ru icon}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{2008 Kansas basketball}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Kaun, Sasha}} [[Category:1985 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Russian basketball players]] [[Category:Russian expatriates in the United States]] [[Category:Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball players]] [[Category:Centers (basketball)]] [[it:Sasha Kaun]]
